# Invocly LLMs Transparency File
# Last updated: 2025-09-05

Application: Invocly
Description: Invocly converts documents into natural audio, with optional voice cloning.
Website: https://invocly.com

# Providers
- Speechify API (voice synthesis & cloning)

# Data Usage
- Uploaded documents are used solely for generating audio and are not stored permanently.
- Voice samples are processed only for cloning and linked securely to user accounts.
- No training of third-party LLMs is performed using user data.

# User Controls
- Users can delete uploaded documents and cloned voices at any time.
- Voice cloning requires explicit user consent.
- Data privacy aligned with GDPR/CCPA principles.

# Contact
For questions or concerns about AI usage in Invocly:
support@invocly.com
